CTET September Exam Date 2026 - Complete Details

Short Details : Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the exam date for the post of Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September 2026 examination. Applications for the CTET September Online Form 2026 were accepted from 25 August 2026, to 01 September 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 12-13 December 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can check their CTET September Exam Date 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 May 2026
  • Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 15-18 June 2026
  • Form Re-Open
  • Application Start Date : 25 August 2026
  • Last Date : 01 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 12-13 December 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • Fees For Single Paper
  • General, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 500/-
  • Fees For Both Paper
  • General, OBC : Rs.1200/-
  • SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 600/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
